# MWEF v0.2.5-pre.1

This pre-release adds recoverable framework updates to Framework Settings.

## Changes

- Added an online update check backed by the official `plugins`-branch framework index.
- Added verified online release installation with primary GitHub and mirror download URLs.
- Added 32 KiB chunked upload-and-install support for official MWEF framework release archives, avoiding the Xiaomi Web service's per-request body limit.
- Added strict framework archive path, type, identity, author, size, and SHA-256 validation.
- Added serialized update transactions, persistent recovery copies, automatic rollback, and plugin/configuration migration.
- Added Xiaomi-style bilingual update controls and release-status messages.
- Documented the one-click `curl -k` installation commands, GitHub mirrors, self-update workflow, recovery behavior, and unauthenticated-TLS limitation.

## Safety

MWEF still performs no MTD write, partition flash, block-device write, Bootloader change, or writable SquashFS remount. Framework releases are staged under `/data/other_vol`; the installed tree is preserved before activation and restored if installation fails.

## Test target

- Xiaomi Router BE6500 Pro
- Hardware code RD08
- Target `ipq53xx/generic`
